paragraph:
# Velmoria's archive

*One hundred and sixty-five years on, a dispute over the national memory tests whether a free people can govern even their own past*

LET THIS chapter turn on a question of memory. One hundred and sixty-five years after the marshal fell, Velmoria faced a quarrel not over power or money but over the past itself—a dispute over what to do with the vast national archive, the (locus) of the republic's collective memory. It was a (heterogeneous) trove: the marshal's own papers, the (muniments) of the founding, the (oddments) and (artifacts) of a century and a half of self-rule. The (onus) of deciding its fate fell, fittingly, on the people.

The archive had grown to a (gross) (excess) of material—a (surplus) so vast that no single (caucus) could (assess) it. Some of it was (peerless): the original constitution, the founders' letters, the (lineaments) of the republic's birth. Some was (dross): the (feckless) propaganda of the marshal's regime, his (bogus) decrees, the (artless) flattery of his court. The question was what to preserve, what to (toss), and who should decide. It was a small question with a (tremendous) shadow.

A faction urged a great (exodus) of the marshal's papers—to compel their (egress) from the archive entirely, to purge the (locus) of memory of his taint. His records were (hazardous), they argued, a (stimulus) to nostalgia, an (incubus) on the national conscience. Better to be (ruthless) and (relentless)—to give the tyrant's memory the (double-cross), erasing the record he had trusted would outlive him—than to let the (dross) of tyranny (oppress) the present. Their (animus) was understandable; their (assertiveness), even (admirable). But their proposal was, in the end, a kind of (regress).

The opposing view was made with (judiciousness). To destroy the marshal's records, however (gross) their content, would be its own (transgress)ion—a (heavy-handedness) that mirrored his own. A republic that could not bear to keep the (artifacts) of its darkest hour was a republic afraid of its own memory. The (onus) of freedom, this faction held, includes the duty to remember without flinching. To preserve the (dross) alongside the (peerless) was not mere (positiveness)—a facile optimism—but a (judiciousness) born of strength.

Recall how the marshal himself had treated memory. He was (ruthless) in his (unscrupulousness)—a (relentless) editor of the past who would (emboss) his own legend and (gloss) over his crimes. He kept his archive as a (locus) of lies, ordering the (exodus) of every inconvenient record, the (egress) of every honest (artifact). His historians were (spineless) and (feckless); his (caucus) of flatterers (artless) in their praise. He would (double-cross) the very notion of truth, treating the national memory as his to (emboss) or (toss) at will. To him the past was a (stylus) for writing his own apotheosis.

The republic, (chasten)ed by that memory, refused both the (ruthless) purge and the (feckless) hoard. It convened a national commission—historians, archivists, ordinary citizens, mingling with an easy (gregariousness)—to (assess) the archive with (judiciousness) rather than (animus). Their charge was not to sit in (oppress)ive judgment over the past, nor to (gloss) it, but to organize it: to preserve the (peerless) and the (dross) alike, to label the (bogus) as (bogus) and the (gross) as (gross), and to make the whole (heterogeneous) trove accessible to any citizen who wished to (press) an inquiry into it.

The work proceeded with neither (leisureliness) nor (restless) haste, but with patient, steady purpose. The commission sorted the (oddments) and (muniments), catalogued the (artifacts), and built from the (gross) (surplus) a coherent record. They did not (digress) into (excess) or lapse into (listless) delay. Their reports had a (pithiness) to match their economy of purpose; they were neither (stingy) with resources nor (heavy-handed) in judgment. The marshal's papers were preserved—not (emboss)ed in honor, but kept as evidence, a (stimulus) to vigilance rather than nostalgia.

There were, of course, those who tried to make (mischief). A (shiftless) populist saw in the archive dispute a chance to (press) his own advantage. He railed that the commission was (spineless) for keeping the marshal's records, then (ruthless) for not keeping them all—a (double-cross) of (artless) opportunism. His positions were (heterogeneous) to the point of incoherence, a (rebus) no honest citizen could (decipher). He sought to (oppress) the debate with (testiness) and (oafishness), to turn a (judicious) question into a (fracas). But the public, in whom a century and a half of vigilance had hardened into settled (mores), saw through his (shiftiness). His (animus) found no (locus) to take root.

The resolution was a quiet triumph of (judiciousness). The archive would be preserved whole—the (peerless) and the (dross), the founding (muniments) and the marshal's (bogus) decrees—and opened to all. A new wing was built on the (outskirts) of the capital, near the old (isthmus) road, to house it. The marshal's papers were placed not in a (necropolis) of honor but in a plain, well-lit reading room, where any citizen could (assess) them and draw their own conclusions. The past would neither (oppress) the present nor be erased by it.

Beyond the archive dispute, ordinary life kept its (bounteous) round. A farmer harvested (asparagus) from his (herbaceous) beds; a cook trimmed the woody (terminus) of each stalk; a child studied the (radius) of a circle and the (genus) of a beetle for school. A (curvaceous) cloud—a great (cumulus)—drifted over the coast; a (hippopotamus) (the zoo's improbable star) wallowed in its pool while children pressed against the rail. A glassblower shaped a (vitreous), (gorgeous) vase; a butcher trimmed the (osseous) waste from his cuts; a carpenter swept the (ligneous) shavings from his bench; a geologist showed students the difference between (igneous) and sedimentary rock. There was a (spontaneous), (simultaneous) ease to it all—the (gregariousness) of a free people at peace with their history.

The episode entered the national (annals) as a lesson in governing memory. A republic, the historians wrote, is tested not only by how it wields power but by how it keeps its past—whether it has the (judiciousness) to preserve even the (dross) without being (oppress)ed by it, the (assertiveness) to label lies as lies without the (heavy-handedness) of erasure. To (toss) the marshal's records would have been a (feckless) comfort; to (emboss) them, a (gross) error. The republic chose the harder, (peerless) path: to remember everything, judge honestly, and let each citizen (press) their own inquiry into the truth.

So Velmoria, one hundred and sixty-five years free, learns that a free people must govern even their own memory—neither (gloss)ing the past nor purging it in (excess), but preserving the whole (heterogeneous) record with (judiciousness) and (candor). The marshal ruled by the (unscrupulousness) of a (relentless) editor, embossing his legend and tossing the truth; his country, a century and a half and more past his fall, has chosen the (converse)—to keep the (dross) beside the (peerless), to face its own (artifacts) without (animus) or (duress), and to treat the national archive not as a (locus) of (oppress)ion but as a (bounteous), open record, where a free people may forever (assess) where they came from, the better to govern where they go.

quiz.question: _____ recess
quiz.explanation: 课间休息; 休会, 午餐休息. Children play outside during lunch recess. 孩子们在午餐休息期间在外面玩耍。 | re->回，cess->走，recess->退回去的间隙=休息/凹处（cf. recession退潮，access进入，concession让步） || 文化联想：中国学校午饭后的课间休息最适合帮助记忆 recess，可以说 **a lunch recess — “During a lunch recess, students may play basketball or chat in the school courtyard before classes resume.”**

quiz.question: excess _______
quiz.explanation: 过度; 超额, 超重行李. Airlines charge fees for excess baggage. 航空公司对超重行李收费。 | ex->向外，cess->走，excess->走出去超过=超额（cf. exceed超过，excessive过度的，access进入） || 文化联想：春运坐飞机时行李超重最适合帮助记忆 excess，可以说 **excess baggage — “A traveler carrying too many gifts home for Spring Festival may have to pay a fee for excess baggage.”**

quiz.question: confess _____
quiz.explanation: 承认; 坦白, 承认罪行. The suspect refused to confess guilt to the crime. 嫌疑人拒绝承认罪行。 | con->共同，fess->说（拉丁fateri->承认），confess->当众承认=坦白（cf. professor教授=公开宣称，manifest明显的） || 文化联想：中文“坦白从宽”最适合帮助记忆 confess，可以说 **confess one’s guilt — “A suspect who decides to tell the truth may confess his guilt during questioning.”**

quiz.question: ________ largess
quiz.explanation: 慷慨赠予; 施舍, 慷慨赠予. The billionaires generous largess funded the new library. 亿万富翁的慷慨赠予资助了新图书馆。 | large->大，largess->大手笔的赠予=慷慨赠予（cf. large大，enlarge扩大，largesse法语拼法） || 文化联想：中国慈善家大手笔捐建学校或图书馆的场景最适合帮助记忆 largess，可以说 **generous largess — “A philanthropist’s generous largess can fund a new library, scholarships, and rural education programs.”**

quiz.question: guileless _____
quiz.explanation: 天真的; 坦率的, 天真的孩子. The guileless child answered every question honestly. 天真的孩子诚实地回答每个问题。 | guile->欺骗（古法语），less->没有，guileless->没有欺骗的=天真的（cf. guile诡计，beguile迷惑） || 文化联想：中文“童言无忌”最适合帮助记忆 guileless，可以说 **a guileless child — “A guileless child may answer an awkward question with complete honesty because there is no intention to deceive.”**

quiz.question: spineless ______
quiz.explanation: 没有骨气的; 软弱的, 软弱的懦夫. The spineless coward refused to stand up for his beliefs. 软弱的懦夫拒绝为自己的信念挺身而出。 | spine->脊椎/骨气，less->没有，spineless->没有脊椎=没有骨气的（cf. spine脊椎，spinal脊椎的） || 文化联想：中文“没骨气”最适合帮助记忆 spineless，可以说 **a spineless coward — “Someone who abandons every principle the moment pressure appears may be condemned as a spineless coward.”**

quiz.question: feckless __________
quiz.explanation: 无能的; 软弱的, 无能的领导. The company suffered under feckless leadership. 公司在无能的领导下遭受损失。 | feck->效果（苏格兰语，effect的方言），less->没有，feckless->没有效果=无能的（cf. effect效果，feckful有能力的） || 文化联想：中文“扶不起的阿斗”最适合帮助记忆 feckless，可以说 **feckless leadership — “A leader who repeatedly fails to make decisions or solve obvious problems may become a symbol of feckless leadership.”**

quiz.question: peerless ______
quiz.explanation: 无与伦比的; 卓越的, 无与伦比的美丽. She possessed peerless beauty that captivated everyone. 她拥有无与伦比的美丽,迷住了所有人。 | peer->同等者（拉丁par），less->没有，peerless->没有同等者=无与伦比的（cf. peer同龄人，appear出现，compare比较） || 文化联想：“桂林山水甲天下”最适合帮助记忆 peerless，可以说 **peerless scenery — “The saying that Guilin’s landscape is the finest under heaven presents its mountains and rivers as peerless scenery.”**

quiz.question: shiftless _____
quiz.explanation: 懒散的; 无进取心的, 懒散的懒汉. The shiftless idler refused to find work. 懒散的懒汉拒绝找工作。 | shift->改变/变通，less->没有，shiftless->没有变通能力=懒散无进取心的（cf. shift换班，makeshift临时的） || 文化联想：中文“游手好闲、不思进取”最适合帮助记忆 shiftless，可以说 **a shiftless idler — “A person who refuses to work and spends every day drifting around may be called a shiftless idler.”**

quiz.question: relentless _______
quiz.explanation: 无情的; 不懈的, 不懈的追求. The detective showed relentless pursuit of the truth. 侦探对真相进行了不懈的追求。 | re->回，lent->放松（拉丁lentus），less->不，relentless->不会放松的=不懈的（cf. relent软化，lento缓慢的） || 文化联想：“愚公移山”最适合帮助记忆 relentless，可以说 **relentless effort — “The Foolish Old Man’s determination to move the mountains is a classic image of relentless effort.”**

quiz.question: bootless ______
quiz.explanation: 无益的; 徒劳的, 徒劳的努力. Their bootless effort yielded no results. 他们徒劳的努力没有产生任何结果。 | boot->好处（古英语bot->补救），less->没有，bootless->没有好处的=徒劳的（cf. boots无益，to boot额外地） || 文化联想：中文“竹篮打水一场空”最适合帮助记忆 bootless，可以说 **a bootless effort — “Working for months on a plan that could never succeed may turn into a bootless effort, like carrying water in a bamboo basket.”**

quiz.question: artless _____
quiz.explanation: 天真的; 自然的, 天然的魅力. Her artless charm made her very likable. 她天然的魅力使她非常讨人喜欢。 | art->技巧，less->没有，artless->没有技巧修饰的=天真自然的（cf. artful狡猾/有技巧的，artifact人工制品） || 文化联想：中文“天然去雕饰”最适合帮助记忆 artless，可以说 **artless charm — “A simple smile and unstudied manner can have an artless charm precisely because they do not seem calculated.”**

quiz.question: restless _____
quiz.explanation: 不安的; 焦躁的, 不安的夜晚. He spent a restless night worrying about the exam. 他度过了一个不安的夜晚,为考试担心。 | rest->休息，less->没有，restless->无法休息的=焦躁不安的（cf. rest休息，arrest逮捕=停止） || 文化联想：中文“辗转反侧”最适合帮助记忆 restless，可以说 **a restless night — “A student awaiting an important exam result may spend a restless night turning over in bed.”**

quiz.question: listless _____
quiz.explanation: 无精打采的; 倦怠的, 无精打采的人群. The listless crowd showed little enthusiasm. 无精打采的人群几乎没有热情。 | list->欲望/倾向（古英语lust），less->没有，listless->没有欲望的=无精打采的（cf. lust欲望，listless同根） || 文化联想：中文“无精打采”最适合帮助记忆 listless，可以说 **a listless crowd — “On an exhausting summer afternoon, even a normally lively crowd may look listless and unenthusiastic.”**

quiz.question: gutless ______
quiz.explanation: 胆小的; 懦弱的, 胆小的懦夫. The gutless coward fled at the first sign of danger. 胆小的懦夫一看到危险就逃跑了。 | gut->内脏/勇气（口语），less->没有，gutless->没有勇气的=胆小的（cf. gut直觉/勇气，gutsy有胆量的） || 文化联想：中文“贪生怕死”最适合帮助记忆 gutless，可以说 **a gutless coward — “Someone who boasts loudly but flees at the first sign of danger may be exposed as a gutless coward.”**

quiz.question: ____________ heavy-handedness
quiz.explanation: 笨拙; 粗暴, 官僚主义的粗暴. The bureaucratic heavy-handedness frustrated citizens. 官僚主义的粗暴让市民感到沮丧。 | heavy-hand->重手，ness->状态，heavy-handedness->用重手处理的状态=粗暴/强硬 || 文化联想：中文“一刀切”最适合帮助记忆 heavy-handedness，可以说 **bureaucratic heavy-handedness — “Applying one rigid rule to every situation without considering local differences can become bureaucratic heavy-handedness.”**

quiz.question: ____ positiveness
quiz.explanation: 肯定; 确信, 坚定的肯定. She spoke with firm positiveness about her decision. 她对自己的决定表现出坚定的肯定。 | positive->肯定的（拉丁positivus->确定），positiveness->确定性（cf. positive积极的，deposit存款） || 文化联想：中文“斩钉截铁的肯定”最适合帮助记忆 positiveness，可以说 **firm positiveness — “A manager who says with complete certainty that the team will honor its promise speaks with firm positiveness.”**

quiz.question: _______ assertiveness
quiz.explanation: 自信; 果断, 健康的自信. Healthy assertiveness helps in professional settings. 健康的自信在职业环境中很有帮助。 | assert->宣称（拉丁asserere->加入/声明），assertiveness->自我主张的能力（cf. assert断言，dissertation论文） || 文化联想：中文“该说不时敢于说不”最适合帮助记忆 assertiveness，可以说 **healthy assertiveness — “Politely refusing an unreasonable request at work is an example of healthy assertiveness rather than rudeness.”**

quiz.question: _________ restiveness
quiz.explanation: 不安; 焦躁, 政治动荡. Political restiveness grew among the populace. 民众中的政治动荡加剧了。 | restive->不安分的（原意是拒绝前进的马），restiveness->躁动不安（cf. restless无法休息，restive拒绝服从） || 文化联想：中文“人心浮动、躁动不安”最适合帮助记忆 restiveness，可以说 **growing restiveness — “When promised reforms are repeatedly delayed, growing restiveness may spread through the affected community.”**

quiz.question: oafishness ___ _______
quiz.explanation: 粗鲁; 笨拙, 粗鲁和虚张声势. His oafishness and bluster alienated colleagues. 他的粗鲁和虚张声势疏远了同事。 | oaf->笨蛋（来自elf精灵，被精灵换掉的愚笨孩子），oafishness->笨拙粗鲁（cf. oafish愚蠢的） || 文化联想：中文“莽撞粗鲁、只会虚张声势”最适合帮助记忆 oafishness，可以说 **oafishness and bluster — “A manager who shouts over everyone and knocks things around may alienate colleagues through oafishness and bluster.”**

quiz.question: _____ stinginess
quiz.explanation: 吝啬; 小气, 彻底的吝啬. His sheer stinginess prevented him from helping others. 他彻底的吝啬阻止了他帮助别人。 | sting->刺（象声词），stingy->像蜇刺一样不肯放开钱=吝啬的，stinginess->吝啬（cf. sting刺，stringent严格的） || 文化联想：中文“铁公鸡一毛不拔”最适合帮助记忆 stinginess，可以说 **extreme stinginess — “Someone who refuses to contribute even a tiny amount to a shared meal may become famous for extreme stinginess.”**

quiz.question: pithiness __ _____
quiz.explanation: 简洁; 精炼, 风格的简洁. The pithiness of style made the essay effective. 风格的简洁使文章很有效。 | pith->髓/精髓（古英语），pithy->精炼有力的，pithiness->简洁有力（cf. pith果皮髓，pithy言简意赅） || 文化联想：中文“言简意赅”最适合帮助记忆 pithiness，可以说 **the pithiness of a saying — “A four-character Chinese idiom can be memorable because the pithiness of the saying packs a large idea into very few words.”**

quiz.question: tackiness __ ____
quiz.explanation: 粘性; 俗气, 胶水的粘性. Test the tackiness of glue before applying. 在使用前测试胶水的粘性。 | tack->短钉/粘性（象声词），tacky->粘的/俗气的，tackiness->粘性/俗气（cf. thumbtack图钉，tack策略） || 文化联想：中国家庭常说的“糨糊很粘”最适合帮助记忆 tackiness，可以说 **the tackiness of paste — “A paper craftsman may test the tackiness of paste before using it to attach delicate paper securely.”**

quiz.question: leisureliness ____
quiz.explanation: 悠闲; 从容, 悠闲的步调. They walked at a leisureliness pace through the park. 他们以悠闲的步调穿过公园。 | leisure->闲暇（古法语leisir->被允许），leisurely->从容的，leisureliness->悠然自在（cf. leisure闲暇，leisurely悠闲地） || 文化联想：成都茶馆里的慢生活最适合帮助记忆 leisureliness，可以说 **a sense of leisureliness — “Sitting in a Chengdu teahouse for hours over tea and conversation creates a distinctive sense of leisureliness.”**

quiz.question: _________ shiftiness
quiz.explanation: 狡猾; 诡诈, 政治上的狡猾. Voters distrusted the candidates political shiftiness. 选民不信任候选人政治上的狡猾。 | shift->转变/诡计，shifty->狡猾的，shiftiness->狡猾（cf. shift换班，shiftless懒散的） || 文化联想：中文“朝秦暮楚、立场反复”最适合帮助记忆 shiftiness，可以说 **political shiftiness — “A politician who changes positions whenever the audience changes may be distrusted for political shiftiness.”**

quiz.question: testiness __ _____
quiz.explanation: 易怒; 暴躁, 声音中的易怒. The testiness in voice revealed his frustration. 声音中的易怒显示了他的沮丧。 | testy->易怒的（来自头部/头脑过热），testiness->易怒的性格（cf. testy暴躁，protest抗议） || 文化联想：中文“一点就着、说两句就不耐烦”最适合帮助记忆 testiness，可以说 **testiness in one’s voice — “A tired parent may reveal testiness in the voice after answering the same question ten times.”**

quiz.question: _____ harness
quiz.explanation: 马具; 利用, 马具. The farmer adjusted the horse harness before plowing. 农民在犁地前调整了马具。 | harness->装备（古挪威hernest->军队补给），harness->马具/利用（in harness->在岗工作，cf. harness energy利用能源） || 文化联想：内蒙古草原上给马套好马具最适合帮助记忆 harness，可以说 **a horse harness — “Before pulling a cart, a horse must be fitted with a horse harness that distributes the load properly.”**

quiz.question: ____ ruthlessness
quiz.explanation: 无情; 冷酷, 冷酷无情. His cold ruthlessness in business was well known. 他在商业上的冷酷无情是众所周知的。 | ruth->怜悯（古英语hreowan），less->没有，ruthless->没有怜悯=无情的（cf. ruthless无情的，rueful懊悔的） || 文化联想：中文“心狠手辣”最适合帮助记忆 ruthlessness，可以说 **cold ruthlessness — “A business leader who destroys partners without hesitation for personal gain may become known for cold ruthlessness.”**

quiz.question: judiciousness ___ _________
quiz.explanation: 明智; 审慎, 明智和克制. The judge showed judiciousness and restraint in sentencing. 法官在量刑时表现出明智和克制。 | judici->判断（拉丁judex->法官），judicious->明智的，judiciousness->明智（cf. judge法官，judicial司法的） || 文化联想：中文“三思而后行、权衡轻重”最适合帮助记忆 judiciousness，可以说 **judiciousness and restraint — “A fair judge shows judiciousness and restraint by weighing the facts carefully before imposing a penalty.”**

quiz.question: gregariousness _____
quiz.explanation: 合群; 社交性, 合群特质. Her gregariousness trait made her popular at parties. 她的合群特质使她在聚会上很受欢迎。 | greg->群（拉丁grex->羊群），gregarious->喜欢群居的，gregariousness->合群（cf. aggregate聚集，segregate隔离） || 文化联想：中国人聚餐时热热闹闹、很容易和大家打成一片的性格最适合帮助记忆 gregariousness，可以说 **natural gregariousness — “Someone who quickly joins the conversation at a large family banquet may show natural gregariousness.”**

quiz.question: unscrupulousness __ ________
quiz.explanation: 不择手段; 无道德原则, 商业上的不择手段. His unscrupulousness in business led to lawsuits. 他商业上的不择手段导致了诉讼。 | scrupulus->小石子/顾虑（拉丁），unscrupulous->不在乎顾虑的=不择手段（cf. scruple顾虑，scrupulous谨慎的） || 文化联想：中文“不择手段”最适合帮助记忆 unscrupulousness，可以说 **business unscrupulousness — “Using fake contracts and bribery to beat competitors is a clear example of business unscrupulousness.”**

quiz.question: ________ fastness
quiz.explanation: 要塞; 堡垒, 山地要塞. Rebels retreated to their mountain fastness. 叛军撤退到他们的山地要塞。 | fast->固定/坚固（古英语fæst），fastness->坚固之地=要塞（cf. steadfast坚定，fasten系紧，fast斋戒/快速） || 文化联想：古代“易守难攻”的山寨或关隘最适合帮助记忆 fastness，可以说 **a mountain fastness — “A fortress hidden among steep mountains can serve as a mountain fastness that is extremely difficult to attack.”**

quiz.question: ____ redress
quiz.explanation: 纠正; 补救, 寻求补救. Victims have the right to seek redress in court. 受害者有权在法庭上寻求补救。 | re->重新，dress->整理，redress->重新整理=纠正补救（cf. address处理，dress穿着/整理，redress grievances纠正不公） || 文化联想：中文“伸冤、讨回公道”最适合帮助记忆 redress，可以说 **seek redress — “A consumer cheated by a business may seek redress through mediation or the courts.”**

quiz.question: _________ egress
quiz.explanation: 出口; 外出, 紧急出口. All buildings must have an emergency egress route. 所有建筑物必须有紧急出口路线。 | e->向外，gress->走，egress->走出去=出口（cf. ingress进入，progress进步，digress偏题） || 文化联想：中国商场和办公楼里的“紧急出口”最适合帮助记忆 egress，可以说 **an emergency egress — “A public building must keep every emergency egress route clear so people can leave quickly during a fire.”**

quiz.question: ________ regress
quiz.explanation: 退步; 倒退, 经济倒退. The country experienced economic regress during the crisis. 该国在危机期间经历了经济倒退。 | re->回，gress->走，regress->往回走=倒退（cf. progress前进，congress会议，transgress越界） || 文化联想：中文“开倒车”最适合帮助记忆 regress，可以说 **economic regress — “If investment, productivity, and living standards all decline for years, the country may experience economic regress.”**

quiz.question: digress ____ _____
quiz.explanation: 离题; 偏离, 离题. The speaker would often digress from topic unnecessarily. 演讲者经常不必要地离题。 | di->分开，gress->走，digress->走偏=离题（cf. progress进步，regress倒退，digression离题） || 文化联想：中文“跑题”最适合帮助记忆 digress，可以说 **digress from the topic — “A lecturer discussing Tang poetry may digress from the topic and spend ten minutes talking about modern television.”**

quiz.question: _____ __ ingress
quiz.explanation: 进入; 入口, 进入点. Security monitored every point of ingress to the building. 保安监控着建筑物的每个进入点。 | in->进入，gress->走，ingress->走进去=入口（cf. egress出口，congress共同走=会议） || 文化联想：地铁站和大型场馆的入口最适合帮助记忆 ingress，可以说 **a point of ingress — “Security staff may monitor every point of ingress to a stadium before a major event.”**

quiz.question: transgress ___
quiz.explanation: 违反; 越界, 违反法律. Those who transgress law will face consequences. 违反法律的人将面临后果。 | trans->跨越，gress->走，transgress->越过界限=违反（cf. trespass侵犯，transgression违法） || 文化联想：孔子所说“不逾矩”最适合帮助记忆 transgress，可以说 **transgress a rule — “To knowingly cross a clear moral or legal boundary is to transgress a rule, the opposite of staying within proper limits.”**

quiz.question: ____ press
quiz.explanation: 新闻界; 压, 自由新闻界. A free press is essential to democracy. 自由新闻界对民主至关重要。 | press->压/新闻（拉丁premere->压），press->压迫/新闻媒体（cf. pressure压力，impress使印象深刻，express表达） || 文化联想：中文“新闻自由”最适合帮助记忆 press，可以说 **a free press — “A free press can investigate public institutions and publish findings without improper interference.”**

quiz.question: oppress __________
quiz.explanation: 压迫; 欺压, 压迫少数群体. Dictators often oppress minorities in their countries. 独裁者经常压迫本国的少数群体。 | op->朝向，press->压，oppress->从上方压制=压迫（cf. suppress压制，repress镇压，depress使沮丧） || 文化联想：“苛政猛于虎”可以帮助记忆 oppress，可以说 **oppress the people — “A government that imposes arbitrary burdens and denies basic protections can oppress the people.”**

quiz.question: _________ distress
quiz.explanation: 痛苦; 困境, 财务困境. The company faced severe financial distress. 公司面临严重的财务困境。 | dis->分离/使难，stress->紧张，distress->造成极大紧张=痛苦（cf. stress压力，stress强调，distress signal求救信号） || 文化联想：中文“捉襟见肘的财务困境”最适合帮助记忆 distress，可以说 **financial distress — “A household facing falling income, rising debt, and overdue bills may be in serious financial distress.”**

quiz.question: _____ buttress
quiz.explanation: 扶壁; 支撑, 石扶壁. The cathedrals stone buttress supported the walls. 大教堂的石扶壁支撑着墙壁。 | butt->推顶（古法语boter），buttress->用来推顶支撑的结构=扶壁（cf. butt撞击，abutment桥台） || 文化联想：古城墙或大型石墙外侧的支撑结构最适合帮助记忆 buttress，可以说 **a stone buttress — “A stone buttress can reinforce a heavy wall by transferring some of its outward force into the ground.”**

quiz.question: _____ duress
quiz.explanation: 胁迫; 强制, 在胁迫下. He signed the contract under duress. 他在胁迫下签署了合同。 | durus->坚硬/严酷（拉丁），duress->严酷强迫=胁迫（cf. durable耐久的，endure忍耐，dour阴郁的） || 文化联想：中文“被逼着签字”最适合帮助记忆 duress，可以说 **under duress — “A contract signed only because someone was threatened may have been signed under duress.”**

quiz.question: assess ____
quiz.explanation: 评估; 估价, 评估风险. Investors must carefully assess risk before investing. 投资者在投资前必须仔细评估风险。 | as->朝向，sess->坐（拉丁sedere），assess->坐在旁边评估=评估（cf. session会议，possess拥有，obsess痴迷） || 文化联想：中国人买房或投资前常说“先评估风险”，最适合帮助记忆 assess，可以说 **assess risk — “Before buying an investment property, a careful buyer should assess risk from financing, vacancy, repairs, and market changes.”**

quiz.question: ____ bliss
quiz.explanation: 极乐; 幸福, 纯粹的幸福. The vacation was pure bliss from start to finish. 从头到尾,这个假期都是纯粹的幸福。 | bliss->极乐（古英语bliths->快乐），blissful->幸福的（cf. bless祝福，bliss=bless的名词，blissful ignorance幸福的无知） || 文化联想：中文“天伦之乐”最适合帮助记忆 bliss，可以说 **pure bliss — “For grandparents surrounded by children and grandchildren at Spring Festival, a quiet reunion dinner can feel like pure bliss.”**

quiz.question: remiss __ ____
quiz.explanation: 疏忽的; 玩忽职守的, 玩忽职守. The guard was remiss in duty during the break-in. 警卫在入室盗窃期间玩忽职守。 | re->回，miss->放开（拉丁mittere->送），remiss->放松了不该放松的=疏忽（cf. remit汇款，emit发射，submit提交） || 文化联想：中文“玩忽职守”最适合帮助记忆 remiss，可以说 **remiss in duty — “A security guard who ignores repeated alarms may be considered remiss in duty.”**

quiz.question: emboss _ ____
quiz.explanation: 压印; 使凸出, 压印标志. The company will emboss a logo on the leather goods. 公司将在皮革制品上压印标志。 | em->使，boss->凸出/老板，emboss->使凸出=压印浮雕（cf. boss老板=凸出的领导者，deboss凹雕） || 文化联想：中国皮具、红包或请柬上常压出凸起的金色标志，最适合帮助记忆 emboss，可以说 **emboss a logo — “A craftsman may emboss a logo onto a leather notebook so the design stands slightly above the surface.”**

quiz.question: gloss ____
quiz.explanation: 光泽; 掩饰, 掩饰. Do not gloss over the serious problems in the report. 不要掩饰报告中的严重问题。 | gloss->光泽（古挪威gloss->火焰），gloss over->用光泽掩盖=粉饰（cf. glossy光滑的，glossary词汇表=对词的解释） || 文化联想：中文“粉饰太平”最适合帮助记忆 gloss，可以说 **gloss over problems — “A report that mentions only good news and hides serious failures may gloss over problems.”**

quiz.question: double-cross _ _______
quiz.explanation: 出卖; 欺骗, 出卖伙伴. The thief planned to double-cross a partner and keep all the money. 小偷计划出卖伙伴并独吞所有钱。 | double->双重，cross->交叉/背叛，double-cross->双重交叉背叛=出卖（cf. cross生气/越过，cross-check交叉核查） || 文化联想：中文“过河拆桥、反过来出卖伙伴”最适合帮助记忆 double-cross，可以说 **double-cross a partner — “A dishonest conspirator may double-cross a partner after the plan succeeds and keep all the money.”**

quiz.question: __________ dross
quiz.explanation: 渣滓; 废物, 工业废渣. The factory disposed of industrial dross properly. 工厂妥善处理了工业废渣。 | dross->金属熔化时的浮渣（古英语dros），dross->废渣/糟粕（cf. dregs沉渣，scum浮渣） || 文化联想：中文“去芜存菁”最适合帮助记忆 dross，可以说 **separate dross from value — “A careful editor tries to separate dross from value by removing weak material and preserving what is worth keeping.”**

quiz.question: gross ______
quiz.explanation: 总的; 毛的, 毛利率. The companys gross margin improved this quarter. 公司本季度的毛利率有所提高。 | gross->粗大/总的（古法语gros），gross->总额/粗俗/12打（cf. grocer杂货商，engross全神贯注） || 文化联想：中国公司财报里的“毛利率”最适合帮助记忆 gross，可以说 **gross margin — “A retailer’s gross margin compares the profit left after the direct cost of the goods with its sales revenue.”**

quiz.question: toss _ ____
quiz.explanation: 投掷; 抛, 抛硬币. They decided to toss a coin to make the decision. 他们决定抛硬币来做决定。 | toss->投掷（象声词），toss up->抛硬币，toss and turn->辗转反侧（cf. tossed salad拌沙拉） || 文化联想：中文“抛硬币决定”最适合帮助记忆 toss，可以说 **toss a coin — “When two friends cannot agree on who goes first, they may toss a coin and accept the result.”**

quiz.question: ____ truss
quiz.explanation: 桁架; 捆扎, 屋顶桁架. The engineer designed a strong roof truss for the building. 工程师为建筑物设计了坚固的屋顶桁架。 | truss->捆扎（古法语trousse->包裹），truss->桁架/捆扎（cf. trust信任，trousseau嫁妆=打包的物品） || 文化联想：中国厂房和体育馆的大跨度屋顶桁架最适合帮助记忆 truss，可以说 **a roof truss — “A large sports hall may use a steel roof truss to span a wide interior without many supporting columns.”**

quiz.question: _______ artifacts
quiz.explanation: 人工制品; 文物, 古代文物. Archaeologists discovered ancient artifacts at the excavation site. 考古学家在挖掘现场发现了古代文物。 | art->技艺，fact->制作（拉丁facere），artifact->人工制作的东西=文物（cf. artificial人工的，manufacture制造） || 文化联想：兵马俑最适合帮助记忆 artifacts，可以说 **ancient artifacts — “The Terracotta Warriors are ancient artifacts that reveal important details about Qin military organization, craftsmanship, and burial culture.”**

quiz.question: ______ lineaments
quiz.explanation: 面容; 轮廓, 面部轮廓. The artist captured her delicate facial lineaments. 艺术家捕捉到了她精致的面部轮廓。 | linea->线（拉丁），lineament->线条/轮廓（cf. line线，linear线性的，lineage血统） || 文化联想：中国水墨人物画用少数线条勾勒面容最适合帮助记忆 lineaments，可以说 **facial lineaments — “A skilled ink painter can suggest delicate facial lineaments with only a few controlled brushstrokes.”**

quiz.question: oddments ______
quiz.explanation: 零碎物品, 零碎物品抽屉. She kept buttons and thread in the oddments drawer. 她把纽扣和线存放在零碎物品抽屉里。 | odd->奇特/单数，ments->物品后缀，oddments->零散奇特的物品=杂物（cf. odds几率，odd奇数，odds and ends零碎） || 文化联想：家里针线盒中纽扣、线头、小别针等零碎物品最适合帮助记忆 oddments，可以说 **a drawer of oddments — “A sewing cabinet may contain a drawer of oddments filled with spare buttons, thread, clips, and bits of ribbon.”**

quiz.question: _____ muniments
quiz.explanation: 契据; 证书, 产权契据. The lawyer examined the propertys title muniments. 律师检查了该房产的产权契据。 | muniment->防御（拉丁munire->防御），muniments->保护权利的文件=契据（cf. munitions军火，community社区） || 文化联想：中国传统房契、地契最适合帮助记忆 muniments，可以说 **title muniments — “Old title muniments such as deeds and certificates can document a family’s legal claim to property.”**

quiz.question: ____ outskirts
quiz.explanation: 郊区; 边缘, 城市郊区. They built a new factory on the city outskirts. 他们在城市郊区建了一座新工厂。 | out->外，skirts->边缘（裙子的边），outskirts->城市外围的裙边=郊区（cf. skirt裙子/避开，suburb郊区） || 文化联想：北京、上海等大城市外围开发区最适合帮助记忆 outskirts，可以说 **the city outskirts — “Factories and logistics parks are often built on the city outskirts where land is cheaper and transport links are convenient.”**

quiz.question: ______ syllabus
quiz.explanation: 教学大纲, 课程大纲. The professor distributed the course syllabus on the first day. 教授在第一天分发了课程大纲。 | syllabus->目录（希腊syllabos->标签），syllabus->课程目录=教学大纲（cf. syllable音节，同源，syllabus复数syllabi） || 文化联想：中国大学第一堂课老师发课程大纲最适合帮助记忆 syllabus，可以说 **a course syllabus — “On the first day of class, a professor may distribute a course syllabus listing readings, assignments, and grading rules.”**

quiz.question: _______ rebus
quiz.explanation: 画谜, 图画字谜. Children enjoy solving a picture rebus puzzle. 孩子们喜欢解图画字谜。 | rebus->用事物表达（拉丁res->事物），rebus->用图画代表词语的谜=图画字谜（cf. republic公共事务，real真实的） || 文化联想：中文“看图猜成语”最适合帮助记忆 rebus，可以说 **a picture rebus — “A puzzle that uses pictures to hint at a Chinese idiom works much like a picture rebus.”**

quiz.question: ________ incubus
quiz.explanation: 梦魇; 负担, 睡梦中的梦魇. Medieval folklore told of a sleeping incubus visiting dreamers. 中世纪民间传说讲述了睡梦中的梦魇造访做梦者。 | incubus->在上面躺（拉丁incubare），incubus->压在睡眠者上的恶魔=梦魇（cf. incubate孵化，succubus女性梦魇） || 文化联想：民间所说“鬼压床”的体验最适合帮助记忆 incubus，可以说 **a sleeping incubus — “In old folklore, the frightening sensation of waking unable to move could be imagined as a sleeping incubus pressing on the dreamer.”**

quiz.question: locus __ _______
quiz.explanation: 地点; 位置, 控制点. Psychologists study ones locus of control. 心理学家研究一个人的控制点。 | locus->地方（拉丁），locus->位置/控制感（cf. local地方，locate定位，locus classicus经典出处） || 文化联想：中文“命运掌握在自己手中”最适合帮助记忆 locus，可以说 **an internal locus of control — “Someone who believes effort and choices strongly influence outcomes has an internal locus of control.”**

quiz.question: _____ caucus
quiz.explanation: 党团会议, 政党党团会议. Members gathered for the party caucus before the vote. 成员们在投票前聚集参加政党党团会议。 | caucus->美国原住民语cau-cau-as->顾问，caucus->党内小集团会议（cf. Caucasian高加索人，可能同源） || 文化联想：caucus 是美国政治语境中的党团会议，可用中国学生学习美国政治制度来记忆，可以说 **a party caucus — “In a class on U.S. politics, Chinese students may learn that lawmakers can meet in a party caucus before an important vote.”**

quiz.question: ____ exodus
quiz.explanation: 大批离去; 出埃及记, 大批离去. The economic crisis triggered a mass exodus from the country. 经济危机引发了大批人离开该国。 | ex->向外，odos->路（希腊），exodus->向外走的路=大规模离去（cf. episode插曲，method方法=沿路走） || 文化联想：春节前大城市出现大规模返乡潮最适合帮助记忆 exodus，可以说 **a mass exodus — “Before Spring Festival, railway stations can witness a mass exodus as millions of people leave major cities for their hometowns.”**

quiz.question: ______ nucleus
quiz.explanation: 核; 核心, 原子核. The atomic nucleus contains protons and neutrons. 原子核包含质子和中子。 | nucleus->坚果核（拉丁nux->坚果），nucleus->核心（cf. nuclear核的，nuclei复数，nucleotide核苷酸） || 文化联想：中国中学物理课里的原子核最适合帮助记忆 nucleus，可以说 **an atomic nucleus — “Students learn that an atomic nucleus contains protons and neutrons packed into a tiny central region.”**

quiz.question: esophagus ______
quiz.explanation: 食道, 食道癌. Smoking increases the risk of esophagus cancer. 吸烟增加患食道癌的风险。 | eso->进入，phag->吃（希腊），esophagus->把食物送入的管道=食道（cf. sarcophagus石棺=吃肉的，esophageal食道的） || 文化联想：吃很烫的火锅时食物会经过食管，最适合帮助记忆 esophagus，可以说 **the human esophagus — “Food swallowed at a hotpot meal passes through the human esophagus on its way to the stomach.”**

quiz.question: _____ asparagus
quiz.explanation: 芦笋, 新鲜芦笋. The restaurant served fresh asparagus with hollandaise sauce. 餐厅供应配荷兰酱的新鲜芦笋。 | asparagus->芦笋（希腊asparagos->嫩芽），asparagus->芦笋（民间误称为sparrowgrass麻雀草） || 文化联想：中国菜市场和西餐厅里常见新鲜芦笋最适合帮助记忆 asparagus，可以说 **fresh asparagus — “A cook may trim the woody ends from fresh asparagus before stir-frying or steaming the stalks.”**

quiz.question: bogus _____
quiz.explanation: 假的; 伪造的, 虚假声明. The insurance company rejected the bogus claim. 保险公司拒绝了虚假声明。 | bogus->假的（可能来自tantrabogus->魔鬼装置），bogus->伪造的/虚假的（cf. bogue假的，bogus check空头支票） || 文化联想：中文“山寨证书、假材料”最适合帮助记忆 bogus，可以说 **a bogus claim — “An insurance company may reject a bogus claim supported by forged receipts or invented losses.”**

quiz.question: radius ____
quiz.explanation: 半径; 桡骨, 桡骨. The x-ray showed a fracture in the radius bone. X光显示桡骨骨折。 | radius->辐条（拉丁，车轮辐条=从中心到边缘），radius->半径/桡骨（cf. radiate放射，radio无线电） || 文化联想：中国中学几何课用圆规画圆最适合帮助记忆 radius，可以说 **the radius of a circle — “When drawing a circle with a compass, the distance from the center to the pencil point is the radius of the circle.”**

quiz.question: ______ surplus
quiz.explanation: 盈余; 过剩, 预算盈余. The government reported a budget surplus this year. 政府报告今年预算盈余。 | sur->超过，plus->更多（拉丁），surplus->超过所需的更多=盈余（cf. surpass超过，plus加号，supplement补充） || 文化联想：中文财经里的“预算盈余”最适合帮助记忆 surplus，可以说 **a budget surplus — “If government revenue exceeds spending for the year, the result is a budget surplus.”**

quiz.question: ________ stimulus
quiz.explanation: 刺激; 激励, 经济刺激. The government introduced an economic stimulus package. 政府推出了经济刺激计划。 | stimulus->刺棒（拉丁，驱赶牲口的棒），stimulus->刺激物（cf. stimulate刺激，stimuli复数，instill灌输） || 文化联想：中国一些地方发消费券刺激需求的场景最适合帮助记忆 stimulus，可以说 **economic stimulus — “Consumer vouchers can act as economic stimulus by encouraging households to spend more in shops and restaurants.”**

quiz.question: cumulus ______
quiz.explanation: 积云, 积云. Fluffy cumulus clouds drifted across the blue sky. 蓬松的积云飘过蓝天。 | cumul->堆积（拉丁cumulus->堆），cumulus->堆积成团的云=积云（cf. accumulate积累，cumulative累积的） || 文化联想：中国夏日蓝天里像棉花团一样的积云最适合帮助记忆 cumulus，可以说 **cumulus clouds — “On a clear summer afternoon, white cumulus clouds may rise above the mountains like piles of cotton.”**

quiz.question: stylus ___
quiz.explanation: 触笔; 唱针, 触笔. She used a stylus pen to write on the tablet. 她用触笔在平板电脑上书写。 | styl->柱/尖（希腊stylos），stylus->书写用的尖笔（cf. style风格=用笔写出的，stylistic文体的） || 文化联想：中国学生用平板触控笔写汉字最适合帮助记忆 stylus，可以说 **a stylus pen — “A student may use a stylus pen to write Chinese characters directly on a tablet.”**

quiz.question: hippopotamus ____
quiz.explanation: 河马, 河马幼崽. The zoo welcomed a newborn hippopotamus calf. 动物园迎来了一只新生的河马幼崽。 | hippo->马，potam->河（希腊），hippopotamus->河中的马=河马（cf. hippodrome赛马场，Mesopotamia美索不达米亚=河间之地） || 文化联想：中国动物园里新生河马幼崽最适合帮助记忆 hippopotamus，可以说 **a hippopotamus calf — “A zoo may draw large crowds when a newborn hippopotamus calf begins exploring the pool beside its mother.”**

quiz.question: ______ isthmus
quiz.explanation: 地峡, 巴拿马地峡. The Panama isthmus connects North and South America. 巴拿马地峡连接北美和南美。 | isthm->颈部（希腊isthmos->颈），isthmus->陆地的颈部=地峡（cf. Isthmus of Panama，Isthmus of Corinth科林斯地峡） || 文化联想：中国学生世界地理课学习巴拿马地峡最适合帮助记忆 isthmus，可以说 **the Panama isthmus — “In world geography, students learn that the Panama isthmus forms a narrow land bridge between North and South America.”**

quiz.question: _________ animus
quiz.explanation: 敌意; 憎恶, 政治敌意. Political animus divided the legislative body. 政治敌意分裂了立法机构。 | animus->精神/敌意（拉丁，来自anima->灵魂），animus->深层的敌意（cf. animal动物，animate使动，unanimous一致同意） || 文化联想：中文“积怨、敌意很深”最适合帮助记忆 animus，可以说 **deep animus — “A dispute that lasts for years can create deep animus between two political or business factions.”**

quiz.question: _____ genus
quiz.explanation: 属; 类, 植物属. The botanist identified the plant genus correctly. 植物学家正确识别了植物属。 | genus->种类/出生（拉丁gignere），genus->生物分类的属（cf. gene基因，genesis起源，gender性别，genre类型） || 文化联想：大熊猫的属名最适合帮助记忆 genus，可以说 **a biological genus — “In taxonomy, the giant panda belongs to the biological genus Ailuropoda.”**

quiz.question: ____ terminus
quiz.explanation: 终点站, 铁路终点站. The train arrived at the rail terminus on time. 火车准时到达铁路终点站。 | Terminus->道路终点之神（罗马），terminus->终点站（cf. terminal终端，terminate终止，determine决定=找到边界） || 文化联想：中国地铁线路最后一站最适合帮助记忆 terminus，可以说 **a rail terminus — “A passenger may stay on the train until it reaches the rail terminus at the end of the line.”**

quiz.question: ____ ___ onus
quiz.explanation: 责任; 义务, 承担责任. Leaders must bear the onus of difficult decisions. 领导者必须承担艰难决定的责任。 | onus->负担（拉丁），onus->责任/义务（cf. onerous繁重的，exonerate开脱=卸下负担） || 文化联想：中文法律常说“谁主张，谁举证”，最适合帮助记忆 onus，可以说 **bear the onus — “A party making a factual claim may bear the onus of providing evidence to support it.”**

quiz.question: viscous _____
quiz.explanation: 粘稠的, 粘稠的液体. Honey is a viscous fluid that flows slowly. 蜂蜜是一种缓慢流动的粘稠液体。 | viscum->槲寄生粘胶（拉丁），viscous->像槲寄生胶一样粘的（cf. viscose粘胶纤维，viscosity粘度） || 文化联想：芝麻酱浓稠、流得很慢最适合帮助记忆 viscous，可以说 **a viscous fluid — “Fresh sesame paste is a viscous fluid that moves much more slowly than water.”**

quiz.question: tremendous ______
quiz.explanation: 巨大的; 惊人的, 巨大的影响. The new policy had a tremendous impact on the economy. 新政策对经济产生了巨大的影响。 | tremend->颤抖（拉丁tremere），tremendous->大到令人颤抖的=巨大的（cf. tremble颤抖，tremor震动，tremulous颤抖的） || 文化联想：中国高铁对城市间出行方式产生巨大影响，最适合帮助记忆 tremendous，可以说 **a tremendous impact — “High-speed rail has had a tremendous impact on how many Chinese cities connect for business and travel.”**

quiz.question: horrendous _____
quiz.explanation: 可怕的; 骇人的, 可怕的罪行. The community was shocked by the horrendous crime. 社区对这起可怕的罪行感到震惊。 | horrend->令人恐惧（拉丁horrere->毛骨悚然），horrendous->令人毛骨悚然的（cf. horror恐怖，horrible可怕的，horrify使恐惧） || 文化联想：中文“骇人听闻的罪行”最适合帮助记忆 horrendous，可以说 **a horrendous crime — “A deliberate attack on defenseless people would be condemned as a horrendous crime.”**

quiz.question: hazardous _____
quiz.explanation: 危险的; 有害的, 危险废物. The factory properly disposed of hazardous waste. 工厂妥善处理了危险废物。 | hazard->危险（来自阿拉伯骰子游戏az-zahr），hazardous->充满危险的（cf. hazard危险，haphazard随意的） || 文化联想：中国化工企业对危险废物进行专门处置最适合帮助记忆 hazardous，可以说 **hazardous waste — “A chemical plant must store and dispose of hazardous waste under strict safety rules.”**

quiz.question: herbaceous _____
quiz.explanation: 草本的, 草本植物. The garden featured many herbaceous plant species. 花园有许多草本植物种类。 | herba->草（拉丁），herbaceous->草本性质的（cf. herb草药，herbivore草食动物，herbicide除草剂） || 文化联想：中药园里大量草本药材最适合帮助记忆 herbaceous，可以说 **an herbaceous plant — “Mint, chrysanthemum, and many medicinal herbs are examples of herbaceous plants with nonwoody stems.”**

quiz.question: curvaceous ____
quiz.explanation: 曲线美的; 丰满的, 曲线美的身材. The actress was known for her curvaceous body. 这位女演员以其曲线美的身材而闻名。 | curv->曲线（拉丁curvus），curvaceous->充满曲线的=丰满的（cf. curve曲线，curvature曲率，curb约束=弯曲） || 文化联想：景德镇葫芦瓶流畅丰满的曲线最适合帮助记忆 curvaceous，可以说 **a curvaceous vase — “A gourd-shaped porcelain vessel from Jingdezhen may have a curvaceous vase profile with smoothly swelling sides.”**

quiz.question: gorgeous ____
quiz.explanation: 华丽的; 绚丽的, 华丽的礼服. She wore a gorgeous gown to the awards ceremony. 她穿着华丽的礼服参加颁奖典礼。 | gorge->咽喉/峡谷，gorgeous->咽喉处精美的装饰=华丽的（cf. gorge峡谷，gorge oneself吃撑） || 文化联想：华丽汉服或舞台礼服最适合帮助记忆 gorgeous，可以说 **a gorgeous gown — “At a traditional-style gala, a performer may wear a gorgeous gown embroidered with elaborate floral patterns.”**

quiz.question: extemporaneous ______
quiz.explanation: 即兴的; 无准备的, 即兴演讲. The politician delivered an extemporaneous speech without notes. 政治家没有讲稿发表了即兴演讲。 | ex->向外，tempor->时间（拉丁tempus），extemporaneous->超出时间准备的=即兴的（cf. temporary暂时的，contemporary同时代的） || 文化联想：中文“脱稿即兴发言”最适合帮助记忆 extemporaneous，可以说 **an extemporaneous speech — “A professor asked to say a few words unexpectedly may give an extemporaneous speech without prepared notes.”**

quiz.question: extraneous ______
quiz.explanation: 无关的; 外来的, 无关事项. Please remove all extraneous matter from the document. 请从文件中删除所有无关事项。 | extra->外面（拉丁），extraneous->来自外面的=无关的（cf. extra额外的，extraordinary非凡的，stranger陌生人） || 文化联想：中文“删掉与主题无关的内容”最适合帮助记忆 extraneous，可以说 **extraneous material — “An editor may remove extraneous material from an essay so every paragraph supports the main argument.”**

quiz.question: simultaneous ___________
quiz.explanation: 同时的; 同步的, 同声传译. The conference provided simultaneous translation in five languages. 会议提供五种语言的同声传译。 | simul->同时（拉丁），simultaneous->同时发生的（cf. simulate模拟，similar相似，simultaneously同时地） || 文化联想：中国国际会议里的同声传译最适合帮助记忆 simultaneous，可以说 **simultaneous translation — “At an international forum in China, interpreters may provide simultaneous translation into several languages.”**

quiz.question: ______ instantaneous
quiz.explanation: 瞬间的; 即刻的, 几乎是瞬间的. The computers response was almost instantaneous. 计算机的响应几乎是瞬间的。 | instant->即刻（拉丁instare->立刻站在），instantaneous->在一瞬间的（cf. instant立即，instance实例，instantiate实例化） || 文化联想：微信消息几乎瞬间送达最适合帮助记忆 instantaneous，可以说 **almost instantaneous — “A message sent through WeChat can appear on another person’s phone almost instantaneous to the user.”**

quiz.question: spontaneous ________
quiz.explanation: 自发的; 自然的, 自发的掌声. The audience broke into spontaneous applause. 观众爆发出自发的掌声。 | spont->自愿（拉丁sponte->自愿地），spontaneous->自发而来的（cf. spontaneity自发性，respond回应=自愿地回来） || 文化联想：演出结束后观众自发鼓掌最适合帮助记忆 spontaneous，可以说 **spontaneous applause — “A brilliant Peking-opera performance may bring spontaneous applause before the final note has completely faded.”**

quiz.question: homogeneous _____
quiz.explanation: 同质的; 均匀的, 同质群体. The study examined a homogeneous group of participants. 研究检查了一个同质群体的参与者。 | homo->相同，gen->产生，homogeneous->产生相同种类的（cf. homogenize均质化，heterogeneous异质的） || 文化联想：豆浆充分搅拌后质地均匀的状态可以帮助记忆 homogeneous，可以说 **a homogeneous mixture — “After thorough blending, a drink can become a homogeneous mixture with the same composition throughout.”**

quiz.question: heterogeneous _______
quiz.explanation: 异质的; 混杂的, 异质混合物. Sand and water form a heterogeneous mixture. 沙子和水形成异质混合物。 | hetero->不同，gen->产生，heterogeneous->产生不同种类的（cf. heterosexual异性的，homogeneous同质的） || 文化联想：八宝粥里米、豆、红枣和莲子清楚可见，最适合帮助记忆 heterogeneous，可以说 **a heterogeneous mixture — “Eight-treasure porridge is a heterogeneous mixture because different grains, beans, dates, and seeds remain visibly distinct.”**

quiz.question: igneous ____
quiz.explanation: 火成的, 火成岩. Granite is a common type of igneous rock. 花岗岩是一种常见的火成岩。 | ignis->火（拉丁），igneous->火生成的（cf. ignite点燃，ignition点火，ignominious可耻的=点火前的黑暗） || 文化联想：五大连池的火山岩最适合帮助记忆 igneous，可以说 **igneous rock — “The volcanic landscape of Wudalianchi contains igneous rock formed when molten material cooled and solidified.”**

quiz.question: ligneous ______
quiz.explanation: 木质的, 木质组织. The plants stem contains ligneous tissue for support. 植物的茎含有支撑用的木质组织。 | lign->木（拉丁lignum），ligneous->木质的（cf. lignite褐煤，ligament韧带，align排列成行） || 文化联想：竹子和木本植物茎中的木质组织最适合帮助记忆 ligneous，可以说 **ligneous tissue — “As a woody stem matures, ligneous tissue provides strength and structural support.”**

quiz.question: vitreous _____
quiz.explanation: 玻璃状的, 玻璃体. The vitreous humor fills the eyeball. 玻璃体充满眼球。 | vitrum->玻璃（拉丁），vitreous->玻璃状的（cf. vitrify玻璃化，vitrine玻璃展示柜，in vitro体外实验） || 文化联想：中国眼科检查里的玻璃体最适合帮助记忆 vitreous，可以说 **vitreous humor — “The vitreous humor is the clear gel that fills much of the inside of the eyeball behind the lens.”**

quiz.question: gaseous _____
quiz.explanation: 气态的, 气态. Water vapor exists in a gaseous state. 水蒸气以气态存在。 | gas->气体（荷兰语，来自希腊chaos->混沌），gaseous->气体状态的（cf. gas天然气，gasoline汽油，chaos混沌） || 文化联想：烧开水后形成的水蒸气最适合帮助记忆 gaseous，可以说 **a gaseous state — “When water boils, some of the liquid becomes water vapor in a gaseous state.”**

quiz.question: osseous ______
quiz.explanation: 骨的; 骨质的, 骨组织. Osseous tissue makes up the skeleton. 骨组织构成骨架。 | os->骨（拉丁os/ossis），osseous->骨质的（cf. ossify骨化，ossification骨化过程，ossuary骨灰盒） || 文化联想：中国解剖课里的骨组织最适合帮助记忆 osseous，可以说 **osseous tissue — “Osseous tissue gives the skeleton strength while also storing minerals such as calcium.”**

quiz.question: bounteous _______
quiz.explanation: 慷慨的; 丰富的, 丰收. The farmers celebrated a bounteous harvest this year. 农民们庆祝今年的丰收。 | bounty->慷慨（古法语bonte->善良），bounteous->充满慷慨的=丰盛的（cf. bounty奖金，bountifully慷慨地，abundant丰富） || 文化联想：中文“五谷丰登”最适合帮助记忆 bounteous，可以说 **a bounteous harvest — “After favorable weather and careful farming, a village may celebrate a bounteous harvest—真正的‘五谷丰登.’”**

quiz.question: analogous ____
quiz.explanation: 类似的; 相似的, 类似的案例. The lawyer cited an analogous case as precedent. 律师引用了一个类似的案例作为先例。 | ana->按照，logos->比例（希腊），analogous->按相同比例的=类似的（cf. analogy类比，analog模拟信号，dialogue对话） || 文化联想：中文“触类旁通、找相似案例”最适合帮助记忆 analogous，可以说 **an analogous case — “A lawyer may explain a new dispute by comparing it with an analogous case that involved similar facts and legal principles.”**
